name: react-vite

exampleDomain.note: Every pack and seam uses the same example domain. The L0 contract passes this value to the seam and the gate's --pair checks it — this repairs the measured defect where the frontend called /tasks while the backend served /notes

fixesVariantsNote: The SPA axis picks the router·global state·server cache all by itself — all three are premises of the pack body. Do not assemble it for a project that chose TanStack Router·Redux·SWR
pkgsNote: oidc-client-ts is used only by the OIDC auth variant (variants/auth/oidc). The self-issued variant adds no packages — refresh is done with the http client and Web Locks (built into the browser)

variantsNote: The auth variant lays down a single resources/auth-and-session.md (login/logout · token storage · session restore · login and callback screens). The web inside a hybrid app shell receives its token from native, so when the shell is unresolved, auth is left to generation as well (shellOverrides)

knownGaps.detail: Consumed 3 times but never defined. It is a pre-existing defect that the original react-aws-frontend-guide also lacked, and this relocation merely exposed it. check_known_gaps in guide-gate.sh reports it as REVIEW
